The four routes

Route 1 — Central Intake

For these specialties a single regional intake triages and assigns. Do not refer to an individual surgeon — the central intake will not forward a misdirected referral.

Route 2 — eConsult — before you refer

For any question that might not need a face-to-face visit. Covers 95+ specialty groups with a reply typically within days. Roughly 40% of eConsults avoid a referral entirely. Best for dermatology (photo-based), endocrinology, haematology, rheumatology, allergy, and any “is this worth referring?” question.

Link
Submit an eConsult

Route 3 — Ocean Healthmap / eReferral

Search any Ottawa specialist or clinic, see current wait times and accepted referral types, and submit from your EMR. This is the practical replacement for a static specialist phone list — listings are maintained by the clinics themselves.

Link
Ocean Healthmap
Link
Who accepts eReferrals in Ontario East

Route 4 — Champlain Healthline directory

Public, searchable directory of health and community services across Ottawa and the Champlain region. Useful for allied and social resources, and for clinics with no eReferral listing.

Specialty routing (48)

SpecialtyRouteDetail
AbortionDirectPlanned Parenthood Ottawa Options Line 613-226-3234 ext. 101, Mon–Fri 12–4pm · ppottawa@ppottawa.ca. Medical abortion (mifepristone/misoprostol) to 10 weeks; typical Ottawa wait 1–2 weeks. Any prescriber may provide medical abortion — no special licensing required.
AddictionsCentral IntakeAccessMHA 1-833-527-8207, age 16+. ConnexOntario 1-866-531-2600 for 24/7 treatment navigation. Rapid Access Addiction Medicine (RAAM) clinics accept self-referral.
Allergy & ImmunologyeConsultHigh eConsult yield — many questions resolve without referral. Then Ocean Healthmap.
Botox (therapeutic)HealthmapRoute by indication: neurology for migraine/dystonia, urology for detrusor overactivity, physiatry for spasticity. Specify the indication or the referral will be misrouted.
Breast CareHealthmapFollow the CCO Breast Screening & Diagnosis pathway map. OBSP self-referral available for average-risk women 50–74.
Body MapsReferenceAnatomical diagrams for documenting injury and pain distribution — commonly attached to WSIB and insurance forms. Not a referral destination.
Blood TransfusionHospitalOutpatient transfusion via TOH and QCH day units. Ontario Regional Blood Coordinating Network holds the provincial protocols.
Concussion & Acquired Brain InjuryHealthmapFollow the Ontario Neurotrauma Foundation living concussion guidelines (open access) before referring.
CircumcisionsDirectUninsured service in Ontario for non-medical indication — patient pays. Paediatric urology at CHEO for medical indications.
Cardiology & Cardiac TestingHealthmapUniversity of Ottawa Heart Institute is the tertiary referral centre for Ottawa and Champlain (catchment >1.5M). Community cardiology also via Ottawa Cardiovascular Centre.
DermatologyeConsultPhoto-based eConsult resolves a high proportion of cases. TOH dermatology plus Bruyère and CHEO sites for subspecialty care.
DentistryProgramLow-income seniors 65+: Ontario Seniors Dental Care Program via Ottawa Public Health 613-580-6744. All others: Canadian Dental Care Plan.
ENT / OtolaryngologyHealthmapTOH Otolaryngology–Head & Neck Surgery; CHEO for paediatric.
EndocrinologyeConsultDiabetes Canada guidelines cover most primary-care-manageable cases; reserve referral for type 1, pump therapy, complex thyroid and pituitary.
Obstetrics & GynecologyHealthmapTOH Shirley E. Greenberg Women's Health Centre is the main referral hub.
GeneticsHealthmapCHEO Genetics for paediatric and prenatal; TOH for adult. Referral criteria are strict — check eligibility before submitting.
GeriatricsHealthmapBruyère Health Geriatric Assessment; Ontario Health atHome for in-home functional assessment. Regional Geriatric Program of Eastern Ontario coordinates.
General SurgeryHealthmapTOH, QCH, Montfort and Hawkesbury all accept eReferrals.
Gastroenterology & HepatologyCentral IntakeChamplain GI Endoscopy Central Intake 613-721-2000 ext. 2061 covers abnormal FIT, family-history screening and polyp surveillance. Non-screening GI consults route via Ocean Healthmap.
Hematology & ThrombosiseConsultThrombosis Canada clinical guides cover most anticoagulation questions. TOH Hematology for malignant and complex benign disease.
Internal MedicineHealthmapGeneral internal medicine clinics at TOH, QCH and Montfort.
Infectious DiseaseseConsultTOH Division of Infectious Diseases. Ottawa Public Health 613-580-6744 for reportable disease and outbreak questions.
Medical Imaging / RadiologyCentral IntakeAll outpatient MRI must go through Central Intake — fax 613-737-8944 or Ocean. CT, ultrasound and x-ray go direct to the imaging facility.
NephrologyHealthmapUse the Ontario Renal Network eGFR-based referral criteria. TOH Riverside Campus is the regional renal centre.
Neurology & TIA/StrokeUrgentSuspected TIA is time-critical — use the TOH regional stroke pathway, do not submit a routine referral. Non-urgent neurology via Ocean Healthmap.
NeurosurgeryCentral IntakeDegenerative spine goes through Champlain MSK Central Intake 613-721-7886, not directly to neurosurgery.
Obesity MedicineHealthmapTOH Bariatric Centre of Excellence — check current BMI and comorbidity eligibility before referring; criteria change.
Obstetrics & Women's Health (Family MDs)DirectSeveral Ottawa family medicine groups provide low-risk obstetrical care. Midwifery is self-referral.
OncologyHealthmapTOH Cancer Centre. Use the relevant CCO pathway map to confirm what workup is expected before referral.
OphthalmologyHealthmapOHIP covers ophthalmology for medical eye conditions and for patients under 20 or 65+; routine refraction otherwise uninsured.
Orthopaedic Surgery & Specialised ClinicsCentral IntakeHip/knee OA → RAC 613-721-7890. Shoulder, foot & ankle, knee, spine → MSK Central Intake 613-721-7886. Low back pain → RAC Low Back Pain 613-798-5555 ext. 13827.
Pain ClinicsHealthmapTOH Pain Clinic. Waits are long — consider eConsult and Ontario chronic pain self-management resources in parallel.
Palliative CareCentral IntakeCommunity support: Regional Palliative Consultation Team 1-800-651-1139 (24/7), fax 1-844-689-1768, office 613-562-6262. Inpatient hospice: submit via Ocean eReferral to Central Referral & Triage. Inpatient unit is the Shenkman Palliative Care Unit, Saint-Vincent Hospital, 60 Cambridge St N.
PediatricsCentral IntakeGeneral paediatrics accepts Ocean eReferral — search “CHEO”. Developmental, rehab and complex needs go through the CHEO Access Team, fax 613-738-4841.
PhysiatryHealthmapTOH Rehabilitation Centre. Has its own defined referral process — check the site before submitting.
Plastic SurgeryHealthmapSeparate cosmetic (uninsured, patient pays) from reconstructive (OHIP-insured) in the referral or it will be returned.
Psychiatry & Mental HealthCentral IntakeAccessMHA 1-833-527-8207, age 16+, covers Ottawa and surrounding counties. Royal Ottawa for tertiary and specialised programs. CHEO for under 16. Crisis: Ottawa Mental Health Crisis Line 613-722-6914. Full program-by-program breakdown (age range, setting, referral pathway, eligibility) under Resources → The Royal — Mental Health Referral Guide.
RespirologyHealthmapTOH Respirology; pulmonary function testing usually booked with the consult.
RheumatologyeConsultSignificant regional shortage and long waits — eConsult is often faster than a referral and may resolve the question.
Sleep MedicineHealthmapOHIP covers Level 1 in-lab polysomnography; home sleep apnea testing is generally uninsured. CPAP funded through the Assistive Devices Program (75%).
Sports MedicineHealthmapCarleton and uOttawa sport medicine clinics accept community referrals.
Thoracic SurgeryHealthmapTOH Division of Thoracic Surgery — regional centre for Eastern Ontario.
UrologyHealthmapTOH Urology; CHEO for paediatric urology.
Urgent Care ClinicsDirectOttawa urgent care centres are walk-in, no referral. Current locations and wait times are listed on Champlain Healthline.
Vasectomy ClinicsDirectOHIP-insured. Several Ottawa clinics accept direct patient self-referral — confirm before sending a formal referral.
Vein ClinicsDirectOHIP covers treatment of symptomatic varicose veins with documented complications; cosmetic sclerotherapy is uninsured.
Vascular SurgeryHealthmapTOH Division of Vascular Surgery. AAA screening in eligible men follows the provincial criteria.
Wound CareProgramOntario Health atHome 1-833-515-1234 for in-home wound nursing. Complex and non-healing wounds route to the TOH Wound Care Clinic.

Found something wrong, missing or out of date? A bad fax number or a retired intake pathway delays a patient. Tell us and we will fix it — you do not need to be sure, just tell us what looked off.
